seams_opened.title: RunEvalRequest has no `confirm` field; the chat fresh-grade sends confirm:true but the BFF run-eval endpoint trusts in_process directly (the in-DOM CostModal IS the gate)
seams_opened.impact: The `confirm` knob rides the run-eval body harmlessly (no extra='forbid'); the actual paid gate is the in-DOM CostModal, not a server-side confirm. If a future hardening wants a server-enforced confirm:true on a paid run-eval (like the optimize endpoint), it would be added here. Today A-SAFE holds because the agent has no path to in_process/confirm and the modal is the only door.

seams_opened.title: verdictShape() in panes.jsx duplicates adapter.verdict_part's projection (two sources of the verdict-card output shape)
seams_opened.impact: The chat-side fresh card and the agent-emitted card are built by two independent projections of the same record. They are field-for-field aligned today (mirrored deliberately), but a future change to verdict_part must be mirrored in verdictShape or the two cards drift. A shared mapping (or the BFF returning the card output) would collapse it.
